children: Equifax Inc reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $1.69B and diluted EPS of $1.79, reflecting year-over-year growth in revenue and earnings versus the 2025 quarter as the company expanded services across its core businesses.
¹ Reported as “Operating revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to Equifax”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per common share”.
Revenue growth was driven by strength in USIS, Workforce Solutions and International businesses, with mortgage and diversified markets supporting Online Information Solutions.
Verification Services showed robust demand across talent, consumer lending and government channels.
International revenue rose about 9–10%, led by local-currency strength in Asia Pacific, Latin America and Canada.
Operating margin improved while higher capitalized software spending increased depreciation, amortization and capital expenditures to support product and platform investment.
The company announced a definitive agreement to acquire Círculo de Crédito and said 2026 planning assumes moderated U.S. mortgage activity amid economic uncertainty.
